confirmed: Only starter template instantiation and invitation acceptance opt into at most two additional attempts.
Exact commit PATCH409, bounded supported error envelope, same transaction ID and failed/rolled_back status are required before retry.
Each fresh transaction repeats current authority, issuer generation, receipt and quota checks; stable request and operation IDs are captured outside the retry loop.
Reviewed retry closures stage database records/receipts/audit/outbox/dispatch intent only; no provider, Storage or wakeup HTTP executes there.
Unknown/lost committed response and other409 paths do not enter the new retry loop; existing exact-receipt recovery remains.

focusedTests.scope: Actual REST adapter with loopback database simulation, PlatformService and WorkerEngine; no Cloud requests

optionalAvailabilityNote: Stream.timeout(15s) is an inter-event inactivity timeout, not an absolute response deadline. New bodies remain byte-bounded at8KiB and Function runtime caps execution; slow continuous trickle can exceed15s. This does not enable unsafe retry. An absolute read deadline would tighten liveness bounds.
limits: No live Cloud deployment/version/GET-transaction behavior attestation.
Other user mutations intentionally retain existing contention/recovery behavior.
No persistent source, Cloud, Git or UI edits by reviewer.
